title: Used Truck Market Outlook
description: Pricing trends and inventory availability for Class 8 trucks heading into next year.
body:
Used Class 8 pricing has steadied after two volatile years, and availability of three- to five-year-old sleepers is improving. Low-mileage day cabs remain the tightest segment.

Every used unit we sell is inspected in our own shop, and we will tell you honestly what it needs.
